primary: vowels5, mean of three seed metrics: reverb-only versus matched clean fine-tuning; separately calibrated at validation FAR1%

research_gate.description: Primary vowels5 requires strictly negative upper 95% FRR difference and FAR increment upper <=0.1pp. Secondary vowels4 reported separately, not used to rescue a failing primary. This establishes at most CV benefit, not noise robustness or deployment.

test_policy: One frozen two-arm three-seed evaluation; no model/seed selection, no recalibration on test
duplicate_policy: exclude all compressed-audio duplicate occurrences in the selected set; exclude all same-split PCM duplicates and PCM matches to existing model data or earlier calibration; retain query slots as rejection, no replacement
